holdout_limit: These chapters were used by earlier experiments. They are excluded from BOTH fitted models in this benchmark; this is not a historically unseen blind corpus.
edge_samples: First 24 eligible paragraphs per heldout chapter; choose uniformly a start of 20 consecutive lexical segments with first and last length >=2. Clip 1..L-1 runes from each outer edge, uniformly. Same window intact and clipped.
edge_mutations: 20 independent one-rune nonzero modular changes in edge positions and 20 in interior positions for each condition. Identical mutations for both models.
apostrophe_samples: First 24 apostrophe-containing paragraphs per heldout chapter, <=10000 runes. Join only adjacent ASCII letter tokens separated exactly by straight or curly apostrophe. Keep per-piece GP encoding before joining, so rune streams agree.
apostrophe_mutations: 20 one-rune nonzero modular changes in apostrophe-connected words and 20 elsewhere, uniform within each region and identical for both models; omit empty regions explicitly.
null: 19 independent exact rune-count permutations per condition, fixed segment endpoints. These are language discrimination diagnostics, not a ciphertext search or significance test.
known_controls: All 8 canonical-consistent fixtures, intact and clipped where both outer segments have length>=2. Same edge diagnostic; no cipher-search inference.
edge_gate: At least 0.02 gain in clipped-edge strict mutation wins; no >0.01 loss in intact edge or either interior condition; >=0.95 known-control wins for the alternative. Descriptive engineering gate only; no automatic unknown-page scan.
inference: Report both fixed alternatives, all conditions and chapter aggregates. Samples/mutations are dependent. No p-value or selection claim. No tuning or unknown-candidate access.
memory: One process; source<=1MB, paragraph<=10000 runes, <=20000 word types per model, existing LRU caches<=100000 each; capped sample counts. No dense search arrays.
